item.title: Hubble 2.2.1
item.description:
# Hubble 2.2.1
- **No more false "Hubble could not quit" warning.** While an update installs, Hubble needs a few seconds to stop its Agent, and it used to warn that it could not quit during those seconds even though the update then installed normally. It now waits, and only asks you to try again if Hubble really can't quit. Updating from 2.2.0 or earlier can still show the warning once, because the version being replaced runs the update. - **A Hubble outside Applications explains why it can't update.** Updates always install into the Applications folder. A copy running from anywhere else, such as your user Applications folder, used to install the update next to itself and restart as the old version. It now says where it is running from, and if Applications already has the same or a newer Hubble, **Open Hubble** backs up your workspace and switches to that copy. Otherwise it tells you to move Hubble and HubDash into Applications.
